q: A complete sentence normally contains at least a subject and a ___.
explanation: A basic independent clause has a subject and a finite verb.

q: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'concise'.
explanation: Concise means brief while still expressing the intended meaning.

q: A useful first step when reading a long academic text is to ___.
explanation: Previewing headings helps identify the structure and main ideas.
A coherent paragraph focuses on one central idea with supporting details.

q: Referencing a source in academic work helps readers ___.
explanation: References credit sources and let readers locate the material used.
